# ToriMed Spa

> Waxing, brow lamination, lash lifts, facials, microchanneling and gel nails by medical aesthetician Tori Kruse in Fredericton, New Brunswick, Canada.

- Address: Inside The Beauty Collective, 191 Main Street, Fredericton, NB E3A 1E1. Parking is free.
- Aesthetician since 2021. Waxing is her specialty.
- Booking: send a booking request at https://torimed.ca/book/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/torimed.spa/
- Google listing: https://maps.google.com/?cid=3807310203583079861
- Prices are in Canadian dollars.

## Service pages

- [Korean lash lift](https://torimed.ca/korean-lash-lift/): A gentler lash lift with a natural-looking curl that lasts 6 to 8 weeks. $150 with Tori Kruse at ToriMed Spa in Fredericton. See real results and book.
- [Lash lift and tint](https://torimed.ca/lash-lift-and-tint/): Your own lashes curled upward and tinted black for a longer, fuller look without mascara. $100 with Tori Kruse at ToriMed Spa in Fredericton.
- [Brow lamination](https://torimed.ca/brow-lamination/): Fuller, lifted brows that stay put. Lamination, tint and wax for $95, lasting 4 to 6 weeks, with Tori Kruse at ToriMed Spa in Fredericton.
- [Brow wax and tint](https://torimed.ca/eyebrow-waxing-and-tinting/): Brow wax $29, brow tint and wax $54, with Tori Kruse, a waxing specialist in Fredericton. Clean shape, more depth, and brow lamination when you want fuller brows.
- [Brazilian wax](https://torimed.ca/brazilian-wax/): Quick, comfortable Brazilian waxing with Tori Kruse, a waxing specialist in Fredericton. $70, about 30 minutes. First-time clients welcome.
- [Waxing](https://torimed.ca/waxing/): Full body and face waxing with Tori Kruse, a waxing specialist in Fredericton. Every price listed, from $15. First-time clients and men welcome.
- [Waxing for men](https://torimed.ca/mens-waxing/): Back, chest and male anatomy Brazilian waxing with Tori Kruse, a waxing specialist in Fredericton. Back wax $58, chest wax $52. Every price listed.
- [Facials](https://torimed.ca/facials/): 30 and 60 minute facials and dermaplaning with Tori Kruse, a medical aesthetician in Fredericton. From $50. See prices and book.
- [Microchanneling](https://torimed.ca/microchanneling/): Microchanneling, a form of microneedling, with Tori Kruse, a medical aesthetician in Fredericton. For fine lines, wrinkles, scarring and acne. $300.
- [Manicures and pedicures](https://torimed.ca/manicures-and-pedicures/): Gel and classic manicures and pedicures with Tori Kruse at ToriMed Spa in Fredericton, plus gel overlay and hand-painted nail art. Manicures from $35.
- [Wedding and event makeup](https://torimed.ca/makeup/): Professional makeup for brides, bridal parties and events with Tori Kruse in Fredericton. 2027 wedding dates open. Send your date for availability and a price.
